notes: EXAMPLE DATA. A fictional event used to show the structure. Not real news.

items.title: [EXAMPLE] Reservoir levels in a fictional region fall below seasonal average
items.what_happened: A fictional water authority reported reservoir storage at 70% of the ten-year seasonal average.
items.why_it_matters: Low winter storage affects summer irrigation, food prices and hydropower.
items.what_to_watch: Pre-monsoon forecasts and any irrigation restrictions.
items.context: Storage is normally drawn down through the dry season. the comparison is with the same week in past years.
confirmed_facts: Storage figure published by the (fictional) authority
items.analysis: If the shortfall persists, food inflation could rise. This is interpretation, not a reported fact.
items.uncertainty: Rainfall in the next two months could change the picture.
